text:
Maria CSM: Heads up — Riverton renewal hits 04/09. Procurement flagged two blockers: vendor code mismatch and they need a blanket PO attached for net30 > $100k. CFO also says any amendment over $250k requires wet signature.
Kevin RevOps: thanks, @Maria. can you paste the current invoice metadata? I want to see billing entity + vendor code we put on our side.
Maria CSM: sure — from our quote: 
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0927
SOW: SOW-9283
Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Amount: $312,500
Vendor code (our side): RDW-ENG-001
Customer PO requested: BlanketPO-2026-RIV
```

Jordan (Riverton): confirmed — our AP team sees vendor code RIS-447 on their side. they can attach a Blanket PO but internal policy requires vendor code to match their vendor master.
Dawn Finance: Jordan — can you confirm the Blanket PO number format? procurement asked for vendor master onboarding form attached to the PO.
Jordan (Riverton): Blanket PO will be "BPO-RVT-2026-11". I'll attach vendor onboarding doc but it'll need their vendor admin to accept RDW-ENG-001 or we need to update our invoice vendor code to RIS-447.
Sophie Legal: quick legal check — changing vendor code on our invoice is fine from a contract perspective as long as the billing entity remains Redwood Inference, Inc. Need an approval record for bookkeeping. @Maria can you capture an email thread from the customer approving the code change?
Maria CSM: will do. action items: 1) get written ok from Riverton for vendor code swap, 2) confirm Blanket PO number + attach vendor onboarding form, 3) confirm wet signature path if final amt stays >$250k.
Kevin RevOps: about wet signature — is that on the amendment only or full contract? we should minimize friction. Sophie?
Sophie Legal: they requested wet signature on the amendment that changes payment terms (net30 + BPO). we can offer two options: a) keep electronic (DocuSign) and add CFO email approval as evidence, or b) wet sign and courier it to their legal. customer preference?
Jordan (Riverton): CFO prefers wet signature for audit trail. e-sign would be faster but they'd still escalate internally.
Maria CSM: ok. timeline: renewal window 04/09 — we need procurement confirmation by 04/02 to get PO + wet signature logistics.
Kevin RevOps: I'll try to speed the finance ops review. @Dawn Finance can you confirm if our AP can issue an alternate vendor code mapping (RIS-447) for this invoice and still reconcile to Redwood books?
Dawn Finance: we can map the external vendor code as a cross-reference, but internal AP needs the vendor master name to match. If Riverton can accept Redwood Inference, Inc. and only reference RIS-447 in the PO, that's ideal. if they insist on replacing our code, we can add a memo field. need procurement email signoff.
docsign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.net/envelopes/0a1b2c — status: sent to Jordan (Riverton) 2026-03-28 14:02 UTC.
Maria CSM: posted DocuSign link in case they go e-sign. Jordan pls confirm if you want to try e-sign first while wet signature is arranged.
Jordan (Riverton): will try e-sign internally; if it stalls, we'll do wet. I'll ask AP to push the vendor onboarding now.
Kevin RevOps: PR: if they e-sign, we should attach an internal approval note to avoid later audit flags. Maria can you cc Sophie on any email where the CFO approves e-sign alternative?
Maria CSM: yep. I'll get the customer approval email and drop it here.
Maria CSM: (later) Jordan — got their procurement note: "We can accept RDW-ENG-001 in PO reference field but vendor master entry must be 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' Blanket PO BPO-RVT-2026-11 attached."
Sophie Legal: thanks, saved to contract folder. this means no vendor code change needed — accounting can map it.
Dawn Finance: confirmed we can reconcile with a PO reference field. no vendor master change required.
Maria CSM: next steps checklist: [x] BPO received, [ ] DocuSign signed or wet signature obtained, [ ] customer email approval of e-sign (if used), [ ] finalize amendment and send to billing.
Jordan (Riverton): I've forwarded the BPO to our AP lead and asked them to action e-sign this afternoon. will update here. :thumbsup:
Maria CSM: thanks all — keeping this thread as single source of truth. if we don't have a signed amendment by 04/02 I'll escalate to AM and Solutions Eng.
Maria CSM: tagging recap for QBR notes: renewal on 04/09, amount $312.5k, procurement ok with PO reference, CFO expects wet signature but will try e-sign, docs: SOW-9283, BPO-RVT-2026-11, DocuSign envelope 0a1b2c."
